Adaptations: imports use Three.js WebGL modules; the CPU liftBelow helper is extracted from wind.js. The procedural branch/species and age algorithms are retained. GMC provides its own WebGL renderer, foliage cards, materials, adaptive camera, contribution markers, staff settings, wind and fallback. No external music or artwork is copied.
